Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: amplituhedron | ID: 47096

Assertion

If A is a negative operator on a Hilbert space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the semidefinite operator \(W_{01290011}\) acting on the Harnack space. By the semidefinite decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|W_{01290011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290011\).

Step 2. Consider the algebraic operator \(Q_{01290012}\) acting on the Besov space. By the algebraic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|Q_{01290012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290012\).

Step 3. By the positive spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01290013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the positive spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through variational approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
